title: The thick-hook meld conjecture
statement: A **thick hook** is the thick-hook family of partitions used in CRIM, and a **meld** is the partition operation defined in the paper. A losing position is a $\mathcal P$-position. **Thick-hook meld conjecture.** A meld of losing thick hooks is losing. This proposes that the losing-position property is preserved by melding thick hooks; the source gives no resolution.
source_name: Ina Bašić, Eric Gottlieb and Matjaž Krnc, “CRIM: A Natural Game on Integer Partitions”, arXiv:2606.16828 (2026).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16828

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of June 2026).
